PR_runtime_relationship: After only CRLF-to-LF normalization, local new resumable/group_access modules and edited GroupLeader/GroupPartner match PR13 head 09fe13bd; local MessageEmitter matches PR14 head 72a994bf. Product source combines changes from two independent PR branches; neither isolated PR head equals the local SDK tree.
T01_conclusion: Current runtime source is an official vendored snapshot plus local increments. Public GitHub fork/PR heads exist locally and in previously captured remote evidence, but local dependency metadata still chooses the copied tree, not either immutable public fork head. AtomGit and a final vendor-to-fork binding are unproved. Do not change metadata merely to declare completion.
baseline_identity: Official 3985 and 94077 SDK Git blobs are byte-identical for all 130 files. The frozen Windows filesystem baseline differs only by CRLF in 128 files; 2 files are byte-identical. This confirms source equivalence without treating CRLF changes as local product changes.
hash_definition: Per-file SHA256 is over exact raw Git blob bytes; lf_sha256 replaces CRLF only. Bucket raw_manifest_sha256 is SHA256 of canonical JSON UTF-8 (sorted keys, indent 2, trailing LF) containing path, byte length and raw SHA256 records sorted by path. Bucket LF manifest uses normalized byte length and hash. It is not a hash of ambiguous file concatenation.
inventory_scope: The complete tracked SDK subtree has 130 official files and 140 current files. The historical source-selector inventory had 129 official files because it excluded uv.lock by suffix. This audit includes uv.lock in inventory and excludes it from runtime code counts.

sdk_runtime_lines.meaning: Physical line counts include comments and blanks. 4220 is the size of modified official files, not newly authored code; attributable runtime delta is +916/-12 across new and edited files. Tests/examples/docs/lockfiles and historical evidence/patch copies are separate.
